mapper.insert: INSERT INTO material_demand_calculation (public_id, region_id, assessment_id, source_type, situation_level, supply_duration_hours, supply_days, affected_population, trapped_population, evacuated_population, vulnerable_population, standard_set_id, standard_version, input_snapshot, warnings, created_by_client_id) VALUES (#{publicId}, #{regionId}, #{assessmentId}, #{sourceType}, #{situationLevel}, #{supplyDurationHours}, #{supplyDays}, #{affectedPopulation}, #{trappedPopulation}, #{evacuatedPopulation}, #{vulnerablePopulation}, #{standardSetId}, #{standardVersion}, CAST(#{inputSnapshot} AS JSON), CAST(#{warnings} AS JSON), #{createdByClientId})

INSERT INTO material_demand_item (calculation_id, material_code, material_name, unit, population_basis, basis_population, gross_demand, current_inventory, net_demand, formula_snapshot) VALUES (#{calculationId}, #{materialCode}, #{materialName}, #{unit}, #{populationBasis}, #{basisPopulation}, #{grossDemand}, #{currentInventory}, #{netDemand}, CAST(#{formulaSnapshot} AS JSON))
